0|c733ab3512431436a26e0381829b45794cb13fb0|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"scsi: qla2xxx: do not abort all commands in the adapter during EEH recovery
The previous commit 1535aa75a3d8 (""qla2xxx: fix invalid DMA access after
command aborts in PCI device remove"") introduced a regression during an
EEH recovery
column2: since the change to the qla2x00_abort_all_cmds() function

column1: calls qla2xxx_eh_abort()
column2: which verifies the EEH recovery condition but

column1: handles it heavy-handed. (commit a465537ad1a4 ""qla2xxx: Disable the
adapter and skip error recovery in case of register disconnect."")
This problem warrants a more general/optimistic solution right into
qla2xxx_eh_abort() (eg in case a real command abort arrives during EEH
recovery
column2: or if it takes long enough to trigger command aborts); but

column1: it's still worth to add a check to ensure the code added by the previous
commit is correct and contained within its owner function.
This commit just adds a 'if (!ha->flags.eeh_busy)' check around it.
(ahem; a trivial fix for this -rc series; sorry for this oversight.)
With it applied
column2: both PCI device remove and EEH recovery works fine.
